### New
- **Players, mobs and items in front of a display get its light.** An entity gets the light where it stands, as bright and as colored as a wall there facing the picture would get, shadows included.
  - Its light level rises with the display's brightness.
  - Players and mobs take on the light's color, together with everything they wear (armor, capes, elytra), as strongly as the display's share of all the light there.
  - Your own first-person hand too. Held items keep their own colors.
  - `entityLight` in the settings turns it off.

### Requirements
- Fabric Loader 0.19.5+ and Fabric API
- Dream Displays 1.10.6+ (client)
- Optional: Sodium + Iris, LambDynamicLights (1.20.1 and newer), [Dream Displays Beam](https://github.com/XCraftTM/dreamdisplays-beam) 0.2.1+ (casts light the room too)

Client-only: servers only need Dream Displays itself.
